messages.subject: Time recording overdue — March
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our records show 9.5 hours of unposted time for the week ending 28 March. Please post outstanding time by Friday so we can run the month-end WIP report. Matters with significant unbilled WIP this month include CAL-0185 and CAS-0184.

Thanks,
Accounts
